messages.author: 10dc0383ca9330d2
messages.subject: RRO version string?
parts: Where may I extract the "Revolution R Open 8.0.1 beta" string for documenting in scripts. To be included with sessionInfo().

messages.author: 0eb5a09fd4de9e5e
messages.subject: Re: RRO version string?
parts:
The version string is in an object called Revo.version - a list with components indicating the version numbers.  This object is similar to R.version that contains the R version details.

Note that Revo.version is not a function, but an object, so don't use parentheses when inspecting it.

Regards

Andrie
